context.transcript:
Attention Central Station customers and MTS riders.
This is a reminder that all next week we'll be operating under a special schedule.
This will include extra trains and bus routes to accommodate increased passenger traffic.
We anticipate thousands of people will be visiting the city to... celebrate 100 years since Platteville was founded.
Trains may be especially busy in the area around the city center and the historic district.
To ensure that your commute will not be disrupted, visit our website for the most up-to-date schedule and traffic information.
Thank you and enjoy the ride.
context.transcript_translation:
注意中央车站的顾客和MTS乘客们。
这是一个提醒，下周我们将按照特殊的时刻表运营。
这将包括额外的列车和公交路线，以适应增加的客流量。
我们预计将有成千上万的人访问这座城市，庆祝普拉特维尔成立100周年。
在市中心和历史街区附近，火车可能会特别繁忙。
为确保您的通勤不会受到干扰，请访问我们的网站获取最新时刻表和交通信息。
谢谢，祝您旅途愉快。
